steps: Open the normal local URL, click Play and then the actual Uppal picker button.
Observe a straight residential lane ahead, with the car clear of the neighboring building facades.
Accept Wow Dry Fruits & More on Prashanthinagar Main Road: 539 m drive to pickup, 597 m pickup-to-customer route, 130 s delivery window after collection, 77 base coins. Save the pre-drive screenshot.
Hold W for 1.0 s without steering. HUD shows 31 km/h and 533 m; street remains unobstructed.
Dismiss the tip, hold W for 1.5 s, then S for 0.65 s. Car visibly advances along the street and stops at 0 km/h, with an open lane and no facade contact. HUD shows 579 m after rerouting.
Save forward-departure evidence, open Pause with P, read warning/error logs and close only this test tab.
uppal.result: PT-006 fresh-spawn forward-clearance check passed once. No turn or reverse was required to leave the initial placement.
uppal.routeLimit: The pickup was behind the chosen driving direction; distance increased after the route refreshed. This spatial check does not establish delivery-route completion or a new distance defect.

steps: Open another normal local URL, click Play and then the actual Charminar picker button. Mecca Masjid, divided road, traffic and roadside buildings are visible.
Accept Domino's Pizza: 198 m drive to pickup, 1,116 m pickup-to-customer route, 204 s after collection, 113 base coins.
Drive W 2.2 s and brake S 0.5 s toward the south-side junction. HUD shows 185 m and 25 km/h.

Dismiss the tip, turn W+D 0.7 s, tap Space once, hold W 2.2 s and S 0.75 s. Car is visibly above buildings with Mecca Masjid to the left; 2.5 s flight charge is depleted to 0.0 s. HUD shows Road ahead blocked · check the map, about 265 m and 41 km/h during the aerial/descent state.

After descent and S 0.45 s, car is visibly at ground level beside the buildings near Mecca. HUD shows Return to a road for GPS · use Back to the road if stuck, about 155 m and 9 km/h. The ground route ribbon is absent. Save the landed scene and open M to save the exact visible map location.

Click the actual Close map button and press R once. Back to the street appears. After the glide completes without driving input, car is at 0 km/h on an open local street; HUD initially shows 319 m and a road ribbon. Later saved pre-departure screenshot shows 313 m at 0 km/h; do not attribute that intervening distance change to the subsequent W hold.

Hold W 1.0 s and S 0.35 s. The car visibly advances along the clear street, the chase view remains usable, and the orange ribbon stays on the visible street surface ahead. HUD shows 307 m and 6 km/h. Save the departure scene and open M for a post-recovery map screenshot.
Read warning/error logs, save the remaining original screenshots and close only the test tab while its map is open.
